g.text: How many sections would have to be
altered to flip the margin of 4,430,191
Each switched vote changes the margin by 2. Threshold of 13
switches per section: standard deviation of the local residual of
1.67 p.p. (measured in this audit), 256 valid votes per section,
|z| > 3. Region to the left of the threshold: an altered section
does not stand out from its neighbors; it only shows up in
aggregate (comparison with other offices, A22, not run) or by
checking printed poll-receipts and the integrity test.
Assumptions: random sample of sections; it does not describe how
